scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard absolute-sum duality and the standard slice characterization of the Daugavet property as reproduced in arXiv:2005.02045. No numerical evidence is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the sliced Daugavet index \(\mathcal T^s\), requires both summands to have the Daugavet property, and does not claim corresponding formulas for \(\mathcal T\) or \(\mathcal T^{cc}\). Full text of arXiv:2607.02227 could not be obtained for inspection.
title: An exact exposed-face formula for sliced Daugavet thickness of absolute sums
